name: Csongrád (Hungary)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Csongrád (a crowned blue shield with a white bird, roses and a heart, with red mantling) above the name CSONGRÁD in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Csongrád arms with crown and mantling
